baseline.sealed_life_support_hulls: authored calm (0 m/s) is their baseline
baseline.source_of_levels: all non-baseline levels are engineering test levels chosen before any result; none is an onboard measurement
baseline.ventilation: ach, hvac_duty and oa_fraction as committed in air_flow_paths.json at the input pin
baseline.wind_source: exporter default; an assumed engineering level, not an onboard or meteorological measurement

contrast_types.matched_perturbation: the same input change reaches both lanes
contrast_types.one_sided_structural: only the ContamX lane has the input; the contrast is ContamX-at-level against ContamX-at-baseline, with the native lane constant by construction. It is not solver agreement or disagreement.

edison_payload.content_limit: One value per hull x lane x setting. No per-zone, per-path, per-deck or per-opening value, no zone or path identifier, no ranking of hulls, zones or paths, and no localized source or release of any kind.

files.coverage_observed.csv: expected against observed status per row_id, with failure reason
files.external_files.json: path, size and SHA-256 of every file used that is not in the repository
files.results_long.csv: one row per row_id x metric
files.timing_raw.csv: one row per row_id x repeat x phase
files.timing_summary.csv: robust summaries per row_id x phase

identity_fields.input_commit: commit whose tree supplies the hull inputs
identity_fields.rule: the three are recorded separately. The manifest hashes inputs at input_commit only, so no file contains its own hash or the hash of the commit that adds it.
identity_fields.runner_commit: commit of the code that executed the cells

offline_checks: run_matrix.csv and input_manifest.json byte-equal to this design's files
every row_id of run_matrix.csv appears exactly once in coverage_observed.csv
git ls-tree at input_commit reproduces every git_blob_sha1 and platform_git_tree in the manifest

results_long_columns.platform_git_tree: tree id of the hull inputs
results_long_columns.reason: free text for any non-ok status
results_long_columns.value: number, or empty when status is not ok/unchanged

edison_payload.separation: A passing input-tree check says the inputs are the committed ones. It says nothing about whether a solve ran, converged or was correct; that is coverage_observed.csv.
edison_payload.status: contract only; nothing is sent in this stage

timing_raw_columns.censored: 1 when the phase hit the timeout
timing_raw_columns.cpu_child_ns: integer nanoseconds; empty when no subprocess

exclusions: No biological agent, infection, dose or occupant model; no point or localized release; no source or compartment identification; no path map; no failure, outage or casualty arm; no ranking.

field_realization_check.failure: the row is field_not_reached and the stage stops; the design is superseded rather than patched
field_realization_check.operational: the summed commissioned terminal flow in the export and the summed native supply flow both change by the declared factor within 1e-9 relative; the realized outdoor-air share equals the declared share
field_realization_check.weather: the Ws/Wd values in the exported weather record equal the level; the count of wind-flagged paths is recorded
field_realization_check.when: smoke stage, before any timing, on every executed row of the canary hulls and once per setting family on every hull

contamx_authored_bundle.construction: committed contam/platform.prj and path_map.json solved as authored; baseline setting only
contamx_authored_bundle.purpose: as-authored reference; never pooled with the comparative arms

contamx_commissioned_export.construction: tools.contam_prj_bridge.export_prj_with_path_map(hobbyist=True, overrides=<per-hull overrides>, ahs_terminal_mode='commissioned'), then engines.contamx_runner.run_contamx and SIM import
contamx_commissioned_export.effective_input_harmonization: Each positive-duty group's outdoor-air fraction declared in air_flow_paths.json is supplied to the export through the existing overrides oa_fraction map and to the import through the existing per-terminal declared_oa_fraction entry field, so all lanes use the fraction the native lane reads. No engine or exporter code is changed.
contamx_commissioned_export.weather_input: relative_wind_speed_m_s and relative_wind_direction_deg in the overrides

contamx_commissioned_export_as_committed.construction: same export with the committed overrides unchanged; baseline setting only
contamx_commissioned_export_as_committed.purpose: shows what the harmonization changes; never pooled with the comparative arms

native_prescribed.weather_input: none; ambient exchange is a declared fixed rate

metrics.comparison: per hull and setting: ContamX minus native, and the ratio where the native value is nonzero; and each setting minus its own lane baseline
metrics.constraint: One value per hull x lane x setting. No per-zone, per-path, per-deck or per-opening value, no zone or path identifier, no ranking of hulls, zones or paths, and no localized source or release of any kind.

per_row.ambient_inward_total_m3h: sum of inward flow over all ambient boundary paths
per_row.ambient_outward_total_m3h: sum of outward flow over the same
per_row.exhaust_total_m3h: sum of AHS and exhaust-only branch exhaust
per_row.hull_balance_residual_m3h: inward minus outward over the whole hull boundary
per_row.max_abs_zone_balance_residual_m3h: largest absolute zone mass balance residual; value only, zone not reported
per_row.pressure_abs_dp_max_pa: maximum of the same; value only
per_row.pressure_abs_dp_median_pa: median absolute path pressure drop; ContamX lanes only
per_row.pressure_rows_unsolved: count of paths without a solved pressure
per_row.return_total_m3h: sum of AHS return terminal flow
per_row.supply_total_m3h: sum of AHS supply terminal flow
per_row.uniform_tracer_closure_error: absolute mass-closure error of the same run
per_row.uniform_tracer_material_time_h: whole-hull material-time of an inert tracer initialized at the same concentration in every zone, 12 h horizon, no decay, no filter credit beyond the lane's own
per_row.whole_hull_air_change_1_per_h: outdoor-air inflow over total zone volume

metrics.pressure_native: not defined: the native lane prescribes flow and solves no pressure; recorded as not_applicable
structural_invariants: zone count and total zone volume equal across lanes
AHS group count equals hvac_zones count
path-map entry count equals the exported path count
every flow finite; every sum reproducible from its parts

numerical_reference.scope: two hulls; historical to this design, not a fleet result

open_items: No execution harness exists for this matrix. tools/contam_fleet_compare.py exports without hobbyist weather or overrides and writes source-specific outputs; it is not used.
The aggregate-metric reducer does not exist; tools/diag/contam_pressure_balance_diagnostic.analyze_field returns per-path data that must be reduced before anything is written.
The ContamX executable is not in the repository. Its SHA-256 must be recorded by the execution stage; the two-hull reference used d14dc8020bd5e9f95962af52f46b7ce85e2899b63306309d6590cec652274b2b.
Timing host is not chosen. Timings from different hosts are not pooled.
Whether the uniform inert tracer metric is kept is decided at the canary readout from closure only, before fleet values exist.
Wind levels are test levels. No onboard or route wind record is in the repository to replace them.

runtime.cached_definition: same interpreter, engine already constructed; only the downstream phase is repeated. Reported in its own table and never compared with a cold phase.

clocks.cpu_child: resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN) user+system delta around the solver call
clocks.rule: wall and CPU are separate columns and are never summed

runtime.cold_definition: fresh Python interpreter per cell execution, inputs read from disk, new temporary directory, no reuse of a baseline field, PRJ or SIM
fingerprint: runner git commit and dirty flag
ContamX executable SHA-256, size and reported version
CPU model, logical and physical core count
runtime.non_equivalence: native_construct and contamx_export+solve+import are different operations. They are reported side by side and as an end-to-end total, never as a like-for-like speed ratio of one step.
runtime.order: hulls in sorted order; within a hull the settings in matrix order; within a setting the lanes alternate first position by repeat index (even: native first)

phases.contamx_import: SIM read and ContamX transport engine construction
phases.contamx_solve: ContamX subprocess, wall time of the call
phases.downstream: the identical aggregate-metric computation, applied to either engine
phases.end_to_end: from input documents in memory to metrics
phases.native_construct: uncached construction of the native engine from the two input documents

runtime.repeats_are_not_seeds: the fields are deterministic; repeats measure timing noise only and support no statistical claim about the physics
runtime.summaries: median, minimum, maximum, interquartile range and median absolute deviation over the measured repeats; warm-up repeats are stored and excluded
runtime.threads: OMP_NUM_THREADS=OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=MKL_NUM_THREADS=1; one cell at a time; no concurrent cells on the host
runtime.timeout: a timed-out solve is recorded as timeout with elapsed equal to the limit flagged censored; it is excluded from medians and counted

setting_application.interaction_reason: heading is expected to be near-inert at the 1 m/s baseline speed, so heading is also tested at the highest speed level
setting_application.not_varied: night_setback, filters, openings, hatches, leakage, zone isolation, equipment outage or any casualty state
setting_application.recirculating_supply_group_oa_fraction: oa_fraction of every positive-duty group declared below 1.0 multiplied by the factor, in all three places named under effective_input_harmonization
setting_application.recirculating_supply_group_recirculated_: (1 - oa_fraction) of the same groups multiplied by the factor, i.e. oa' = 1 - factor x (1 - oa); stays below 1.0
setting_application.relative_wind_direction: overrides relative_wind_direction_deg, degrees from ahead, in [0, 360)
setting_application.relative_wind_speed: overrides relative_wind_speed_m_s; heading stays at baseline
setting_application.supply_group_ach: ach of every group with positive duty multiplied by the factor. Both solvers use ach x duty as a product on these groups, so this row must equal supply_duty_x1p5; a difference is a finding
setting_application.supply_group_hvac_duty: hvac_duty of every group with positive duty multiplied by the factor; duty-0 groups unchanged

stage: pre-results design freeze; no field solved, no solver timed

stages.canary_rule: the two CONTAM-PHASE3-BASELINE-01 hulls, the hulls with the fewest and the most zones (ties by name), and the first sealed life-support hull by name
stages.next_stage: smoke and canary: build the runner, pass the field realization check, run only the canary hulls, read out, stop
stages.stop_boundary: no hull outside the canary set is run until the canary readout is reviewed and the fleet run is approved

observed.failed: export, solve or import raised; reason recorded
observed.field_not_reached: the setting did not change the realized input fields; values are withheld
observed.ok: solved and imported; values are numbers, zero included
observed.timeout: solver exceeded the timeout; reason recorded
observed.unchanged: ok, and every metric equals the lane baseline within the declared tolerance
observed.unimplemented: the runner has no implementation of the cell

planned.not_applicable: the parameter does not exist on this hull
planned.planned_execute: the cell is run and timed
planned.structural_nonresponse: the lane has no input for the parameter; the baseline value is carried by reference and nothing is run or timed

status_vocabulary.rule: A metric is a number only when observed status is ok or unchanged; otherwise it is empty, never 0.
status_vocabulary.unchanged_tolerance: relative 1e-9 or absolute 1e-9 in the metric's unit, whichever is larger
